description: Header file defining the CoalescingCertVerifier class, which manages in-flight certificate verification requests by coalescing similar requests to optimize performance. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and internal data structures.

classes.name: CoalescingCertVerifier
classes.description: A CertVerifier that coalesces in-flight verification requests with matching parameters, reducing redundant verification calls.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Internal class representing a verification job, details not provided in the header.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Internal class representing a verification request, details not provided in the header.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Performs certificate verification, potentially joining an existing in-flight request if parameters match.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for verifier changes.

methods.name: requests_for_testing
methods.description: Returns the number of requests made, for testing purposes.

methods.name: inflight_joins_for_testing
methods.description: Returns the number of inflight joins, for testing purposes.

methods.name: FindJob
methods.description: Finds an existing job matching request parameters.

methods.name: IncrementGenerationAndMakeCurrentJobsUnjoinable
methods.description: Updates internal state to prevent new joins after configuration change.

methods.name: OnCertVerifierChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the underlying certificate verifier.
